title: LLAVAGUARD: An Open VLM-based Framework for Safeguarding Vision Datasets and Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on building a safety framework based on a 'socio-moral' taxonomy. It specifically utilizes the 'Socio-Moral Image Database (SMID)' as a foundation for its dataset and develops guidelines to evaluate categories such as hate, humiliation, and cruelty, which are inherently ethical and moral assessments.
